raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

UniBoost (*Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference*, ICML 2026, [project page](https://yl3469.github.io/uniboost-icml26/#cite), [arXiv:2606.18431](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18431)) is a prediction-free, tail-aware schedule policy. A waiting request `r` is served in ascending

```
phi(r) = A(r) - b_gamma(q(u(r)))      b_gamma(w) = -ln(1 - exp(-gamma * w)) / gamma
```

where `A(r)` is its arrival stamp, `u(r)` its uncached prefill work and `q()` a geometric quantization at bin size `k`. Small work gets a large boost and large work almost none, and no boost exceeds `b_gamma(k)`. So a newcomer can only overtake requests that arrived less than `b_gamma(k)` earlier: large `gamma` converges to FCFS, small `gamma` to shortest-uncached-work-first, and every request's wait has a bound.

The existing policies sit at the two ends. `fcfs` bounds waits but ignores work; `lpm` and `shortest-prefill-first` favor cheap requests with no starvation bound; `hrrn` ages by waited tokens. UniBoost interpolates between them with one knob and an explicit bound.

This PR adds the policy as `--schedule-policy uniboost` with a fixed `gamma`. The follow-ups below add the paper's adaptive gamma and two serving-side extensions.

**UniBoost series** (each PR builds on the previous one; review in order):
1. #48076: the policy (`--schedule-policy uniboost`)
2. #48077: adaptive gamma from the response-time tail
3. #48078: bounded waits for requests that share a prefix
4. #48079: decode time-slicing for first-token-starved waiters

All four target `main`, so #48077 to #48079 also carry the commits of the PRs before them; each PR's own change is its last commit.

## Modifications

- `managers/uniboost.py` (new): the boost `b_gamma` (paper Eq. 2), the geometric bin `q` (Eq. 8), uncached work `u(r)` (input plus generated tokens minus the matched prefix), and the queue sort.
  - **Clock** (`--uniboost-clock`): `tokens` (the paper's clock: prefill tokens processed by this scheduler) or `wall` (arrival in seconds, with work converted to seconds at the measured prefill token rate, an EMA in `TokenClockRate`). Under `wall`, `gamma` is in 1/s and its meaning does not drift with the cache hit rate.
  - Arrival stamps are taken the first time the policy sees a request and survive retraction, so a retracted request keeps its seniority.
  - Sort key: priority first when `--enable-priority-scheduling` is on, then `phi`. In-batch prefix-dedup followers sort last, as under the other cache-aware policies. Ties break on `A(r)`, then rid.
- `managers/schedule_policy.py`: `CacheAwarePolicy.UNIBOOST`, dispatched from `calc_priority`.
  - Without a prefix cache it falls back to `fcfs` with a warning, like the other cache-aware policies.
  - It keeps its order on long queues, whereas `lpm` and `hrrn` switch to `fcfs` above 128 waiting requests: a bounded wait that disappears under load would defeat the policy.
- `managers/scheduler.py`: passes the knobs to `SchedulePolicy`.
- `managers/schedule_batch.py`: two `Req` fields for the arrival stamps.
- `arg_groups/`: `--uniboost-gamma` (unset means 1e-4 per token, or 0.1 1/s under `wall`), `--uniboost-bin-size` (256) and `--uniboost-clock` (`tokens`), with validation. `uniboost` is allowed with `--enable-priority-scheduling`.
- `docs/.../server_arguments.mdx`: the new choice and flags.

## Accuracy Tests

The policy only changes the order in which waiting requests are admitted. Model forward, KV cache contents and sampling are untouched, so each request's output is unchanged.

No GPU accuracy run on main yet. The KV path this series touches is limited to #48079 (released decodes are checkpointed and resume from the radix cache); a gsm8k check with forced releases can be added on request.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The table is the complete series; this PR is its ordering layer, and the time-slicing in #48079 is what moves the memory-bound tail.

GLM-5.3 W4AFP8 production configuration on 8xH200: TP8 / attention-DP8 / EP8, DeepEP, EAGLE (3/1/4), HiCache write-back (128 GB host), prefill delayer, page size 64, behind the dynamo 1.6.1 frontend (`--router-mode kv`). Workload: agentic coding traces (`semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126_256k`; context up to 256k, mean ~97k, input:output ~92:1), concurrency 64, seed 77188, 3600 s; the table counts the requests sent in the first 1800 s. One run per policy, same image and frontend config except the policy flags. KV usage was >= 0.9 on 16-20% of decode-step logs in every run (memory-bound overload).

The uniboost row is the complete series (#48076 to #48079) in the configuration `--schedule-policy uniboost --uniboost-bin-size 256 --uniboost-clock wall --uniboost-adaptive-gamma --uniboost-adaptive-max-jump-s 50 --uniboost-preempt-wait-s 30 --uniboost-preempt-quantum-tokens 512 --uniboost-preempt-max-per-req 2`. It was measured on a port of this series to sglang v0.5.21 (flag prefix `--boost-` there; the policy logic is the same). Two things in that build are not part of this series: a 60 s cap on how long an in-batch prefix-dedup follower is held back (`--in-batch-prefix-caching-max-pin-s 60`, applied to lpm, hrrn and uniboost), and a guard that re-queued a prefill batch whose KV allocation failed (it fired 3 times in the uniboost run and never in the others; see the note in #48079). Q = queue wait from arrival to first admission; Jain = Jain's fairness index over queue waits (higher is fairer).

| Policy | n | TTFT mean (s) | TTFT p95 | TTFT p99 | ITL mean (ms) | ITL p99 | Tok/s | Jain | Q mean (s) | Q p99 | Q > 60 s | Q > 120 s | Q max (s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| dfs-weight | 1074 | 11.1 | 42.8 | 114 | 929 | 10001 | **362.7** | 0.117 | 8.4 | 110 | 36 | 8 | 279 |
| lpm | 1054 | 12.0 | 50.0 | 118 | 997 | 10947 | 330.9 | 0.143 | 9.2 | 115 | 41 | 9 | **223** |
| fcfs | 1061 | 11.3 | 39.4 | 120 | **924** | **9930** | 359.2 | 0.132 | 8.4 | 118 | 23 | 11 | 299 |
| hrrn | 996 | 13.7 | 52.9 | 128 | 1073 | 11633 | 323.1 | **0.152** | 10.5 | 121 | 40 | 11 | 274 |
| **uniboost (#48076-#48079)** | 1088 | **9.8** | **35.9** | **71.9** | 999 | 11321 | 352.3 | 0.134 | **7.0** | **70.7** | **15** | **4** | 260 |

Against dfs-weight, uniboost cuts TTFT p99 by 37% and Q p99 by 36%, and requests that waited more than 60 s from 36 to 15. The cost is decode speed: ITL mean +7.5%, ITL p99 +13%, Tok/s -2.9%.

**Unit tests** (CPU, `pytest` per file on this branch):

- `test/registered/unit/managers/test_uniboost.py` (new): 25 passed
- `test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py`: 351 passed, including the new `TestUniBoostPolicyArgs`
- The 51 existing unit-test files that import, fake or stand in for the touched modules: 49 pass. The other 2 fail identically on the base commit `4dc6070f58` in our environment: `api/v1/test_parity.py`, `mem_cache/unified_radix_cache/test_unified_radix_cache_load_back.py`.
- `pre-commit run --files <changed files>`: all hooks pass.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Citation

UniBoost is from *Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference* (ICML 2026): https://yl3469.github.io/uniboost-icml26/#cite

```bibtex
@inproceedings{li2026beyondprediction,
  title     = {Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference},
  author    = {Yueying Li and Yuanfan Chen and Jiayang Chen and Esha Choukse
               and Haoran Qiu and G. Edward Suh and Rodrigo Fonseca
               and Ziv Scully and Udit Gupta},
  booktitle = {International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML)},
  year      = {2026},
}
```

+"""UniBoost schedule policy.
+
+Y. Li et al. "Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference", ICML 2026.
+https://yl3469.github.io/uniboost-icml26/ (arXiv:2606.18431).
+
+A waiting request r is served in ascending
+
+    phi(r) = A(r) - b_gamma(q(u(r)))
+
+where A(r) is its first-queue-entry stamp, u(r) its uncached prefill work,
+q() a geometric quantization at bin size k and b_gamma(w) =
+-ln(1 - exp(-gamma * w)) / gamma a boost that is large for small work and
+vanishes for large work. b_gamma(k) is the largest boost any request can get,
+so a newcomer can overtake only requests that arrived less than b_gamma(k)
+earlier: large gamma converges to FCFS, small gamma to shortest-uncached-work.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, List, Optional, Sequence, Set
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req
+
+
+class UniBoostClock(Enum):
+    """Axis of A(r) and u(r); see --uniboost-clock."""
+
+    # Prefill tokens processed by this scheduler (the paper's clock).
+    TOKENS = "tokens"
+    # Wall seconds; work is converted at the measured token-clock rate.
+    WALL = "wall"
+
+
+# Unset --uniboost-gamma. Tokens: the paper's per-token scale. Wall: geometric
+# center of the gamma-Ada fit's fixed points measured at concurrency 4-16 on
+# agentic traces (0.017-0.62 1/s).
+DEFAULT_GAMMA = {UniBoostClock.TOKENS: 1e-4, UniBoostClock.WALL: 0.1}
+
+
+def boost(work: float, gamma: float) -> float:
+    """b_gamma(w) = -ln(1 - exp(-gamma * w)) / gamma (paper Eq. 2)."""
+    x = gamma * work
+    if x <= 0:
+        return float("inf")
+    v = -math.expm1(-x)
+    if v >= 1.0:
+        # 1 - exp(-x) rounds to 1.0 for large x; the boost underflows to 0.
+        return 0.0
+    return -math.log(v) / gamma
+
+
+def geometric_bin(work: int, bin_size: int) -> int:
+    """q(u) = k * 2^floor(log2(max(u, k) / k)) (paper Eq. 8)."""
+    return bin_size * 2 ** math.floor(math.log2(max(work, bin_size) / bin_size))
+
+
+def uncached_work(req: Req) -> int:
+    """Tokens left to prefill: input plus generated (re-prefilled after a
+    retraction) minus the matched prefix (device and host hits)."""
+    return max(
+        1,
+        len(req.origin_input_ids) + len(req.output_ids) - req.num_matched_prefix_tokens,
+    )
+
+
+class TokenClockRate:
+    """EMA of the token clock's rate (counted prefill tokens per wall second),
+    used by the wall clock to turn uncached tokens into seconds of service."""
+
+    BETA = 0.2
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._last_tokens: Optional[int] = None
+        self._last_t: Optional[float] = None
+        self._tokens_per_s: Optional[float] = None
+
+    @property
+    def tokens_per_s(self) -> Optional[float]:
+        return self._tokens_per_s
+
+    def observe(self, processed_tokens: int, now_s: float) -> Optional[float]:
+        if self._last_tokens is None:
+            self._last_tokens = processed_tokens
+            self._last_t = now_s
+            return self._tokens_per_s
+        delta_tokens = processed_tokens - self._last_tokens
+        delta_s = now_s - self._last_t
+        # An idle or decode-only stretch takes no sample and keeps the
+        # baseline, so it folds into the next sample's window.
+        if delta_tokens > 0 and delta_s > 0:
+            sample = delta_tokens / delta_s
+            self._last_tokens = processed_tokens
+            self._last_t = now_s
+            if self._tokens_per_s is None:
+                self._tokens_per_s = sample
+            else:
+                self._tokens_per_s = (
+                    1.0 - self.BETA
+                ) * self._tokens_per_s + self.BETA * sample
+        return self._tokens_per_s
+
+
+def stamp_arrivals(
+    waiting_queue: Sequence[Req], *, processed_tokens: int, now_s: float
+) -> None:
+    """Stamps A(r) the first time the policy sees r; a retracted request that
+    re-enters the queue keeps its original stamps."""
+    for r in waiting_queue:
+        if r.uniboost_arrival_tokens is None:
+            r.uniboost_arrival_tokens = processed_tokens
+            r.uniboost_arrival_s = now_s
+
+
+def sort_waiting_queue(
+    waiting_queue: List[Req],
+    *,
+    gamma: float,
+    bin_size: int,
+    clock: UniBoostClock,
+    rate_tokens_per_s: Optional[float],
+    temporary_deprioritized: Set[str],
+    enable_priority_scheduling: bool,
+    priority_sign: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Sorts by ascending phi(r); see the module docstring.
+
+    Wall clock: A(r) is in seconds and work becomes u(r) / rate seconds, so
+    gamma is in 1/s; until the rate is measured the boost is 0 (FCFS).
+
+    In-batch prefix-dedup followers sort last, as under the other cache-aware
+    policies. Ties break by A(r), then rid.
+    """
+    wall = clock is UniBoostClock.WALL
+
+    def arrival(r: Req) -> float:
+        stamp = r.uniboost_arrival_s if wall else r.uniboost_arrival_tokens
+        return stamp if stamp is not None else 0.0
+
+    def phi(r: Req) -> float:
+        w = geometric_bin(uncached_work(r), bin_size)
+        if not wall:
+            return arrival(r) - boost(w, gamma)
+        if rate_tokens_per_s is None:
+            return arrival(r)
+        return arrival(r) - boost(w / rate_tokens_per_s, gamma)
+
+    def key(r: Req):
+        group, rank = 0, phi(r)
+        if r.rid in temporary_deprioritized:
+            group, rank = 1, 0.0
+        if enable_priority_scheduling:
+            return (r.priority * priority_sign, group, rank, arrival(r), r.rid)
+        return (group, rank, arrival(r), r.rid)
+
+    waiting_queue.sort(key=key)

+    if output:

+    def test_nonincreasing_in_work_and_strict_while_positive(self):
+        for gamma in (1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-3, 1.0):
+            boosts = [boost(2.0**i, gamma) for i in range(30)]
+            for larger, smaller in zip(boosts, boosts[1:]):
+                self.assertGreaterEqual(larger, smaller)
+                if larger > 0.0:
+                    self.assertGreater(larger, smaller)
+
+    def test_finite_and_nonnegative_across_the_domain(self):
+        # gamma * work past ~40 rounds 1 - exp(-x) to 1.0: the underflow branch.
+        for gamma in (1e-8, 1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-2, 1.0):
+            for work in (1e-4, 1e-1, 1.0, 10.0, 1e3, 1e6, 8e6, 1e9):
+                value = boost(work, gamma)
+                self.assertTrue(math.isfinite(value), (gamma, work, value))
+                self.assertGreaterEqual(value, 0.0)
+        self.assertEqual(boost(8_000_000.0, 1e-4), 0.0)

+        # q(u) >= k and b is decreasing, so b(q(u)) <= b(k), equal for u <= k.
+        k, gamma = 256, 1e-4
+        ceiling = boost(k, gamma)
+        for u in (1, k, k + 1, 2 * k, 3 * k, 100_000, 262_144):
+            self.assertLessEqual(boost(geometric_bin(u, k), gamma), ceiling)
+        self.assertEqual(boost(geometric_bin(1, k), gamma), ceiling)

+        policy = _policy(uniboost_gamma=0.01, uniboost_clock="wall")
+        # Replaces only schedule_policy's binding of the time module.
+        with patch("sglang.srt.managers.schedule_policy.time") as clock:
+            clock.perf_counter.side_effect = [0.0, 1.0]
+            queue = policy.calc_priority(queue, processed_tokens=0)
+            self.assertEqual([r.rid for r in queue], ["cold", "hot"])
+            queue = policy.calc_priority(queue, processed_tokens=30_000)
+        self.assertEqual(policy.uniboost_rate.tokens_per_s, 30_000.0)
+        # At 30k tok/s and gamma 0.01 1/s hot's boost (~937 s) beats its 100 s lag.
+        self.assertEqual([r.rid for r in queue], ["hot", "cold"])
+
+    def test_unset_gamma_takes_the_clock_default(self):
+        self.assertEqual(_policy().uniboost_gamma, 1e-4)
+        self.assertEqual(_policy(uniboost_clock="wall").uniboost_gamma, 0.1)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _policy(uniboost_clock="wall", uniboost_gamma=0.05).uniboost_gamma, 0.05
+        )
+
+    def test_large_queue_keeps_uniboost(self):
+        queue = [_make_req(f"r{i}", [i]) for i in range(200)]
+        policy = _policy()
+        self.assertIs(policy._determine_active_policy(queue), CacheAwarePolicy.UNIBOOST)
+
+    def test_without_prefix_cache_falls_back_to_fcfs(self):
+        with self.assertLogs("sglang.srt.managers.schedule_policy", level="WARNING"):
+            policy = _policy(tree_cache=RadixCache.create_simulated(disable=True))
+        self.assertIs(policy.policy, CacheAgnosticPolicy.FCFS)

+class TestUniBoostPolicyArgs(CustomTestCase):
+    def _checked(self, **kwargs):
+        directory = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="uniboost_args_")
+        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, directory, ignore_errors=True)
+        with open(os.path.join(directory, "config.json"), "w") as handle:
+            json.dump(
+                {
+                    "architectures": ["LlamaForCausalLM"],
+                    "model_type": "llama",
+                    "hidden_size": 16,
+                    "intermediate_size": 32,
+                    "num_attention_heads": 2,
+                    "num_key_value_heads": 2,
+                    "num_hidden_layers": 2,
+                    "vocab_size": 128,
+                    "max_position_embeddings": 2048,
+                },
+                handle,
+            )
+        args = ServerArgs(model_path=directory, device="cuda", **kwargs)
+        args.resolve_once()
+        args.check_server_args()
+        return args
+
+    def test_invalid_knobs_are_rejected(self):

+            self._checked(schedule_policy="uniboost", uniboost_bin_size=0)
